commits.subject: CAPSTONE: SymPowData + birationality ==> Milne III.6.1, end to end, AXIOM-CLEAN
commits.summary:
**End to end.** From $\mathrm{SymPowData}$ and Milne III.5.1(a) birationality alone, Milne Proposition III.6.1 follows — axiom-clean, no `sorry`-bodied object in any hypothesis.

**What this does and does not claim.** It finishes Milnes *argument*; it does not construct $\mathrm{Sym}^g C$, and it does not discharge AlbaneseUP.leans six pinned sorries — it makes them unnecessary.
